en.lvl1RuleText: When a sum has × and +, solve Multiplication first, then +.
en.lvl2RuleText: When a sum has × and −, solve × first, then −.
en.lvl3RuleText: When a sum has ÷ and + or −, solve ÷ first.
en.lvl4RuleText: When a sum has + and −, solve from LEFT to RIGHT.
en.lvl5RuleText: When a sum has × and ÷, solve from LEFT to RIGHT.
en.lvl6RuleText: When a sum has ( ), solve inside the ( ) first.

en.lvl6BodmasTag: Brackets are solved before everything else.
